|strategy=By [mailto:Zmanthe1st@aol.com Zmanthe1st@aol.com]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/drop.html</ref>

How many people, when playing a game, wished they had a [[Monnok]] to slow down the opponent, or a [[Reactor Terminal]] to start tracking, and recycle cards, but never had the room for them? Well, [[Drop!]] provides the ideal solution.

You see the opponent has [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] coming down onto the table. Your [[Lord Vader]] fiddles with his lightsaber, tinkering it to maximum efficiency. You know, now, with the new cards, he will most probably duel in a few turns. [[The Circle Is Now Complete]] looks good right now, but you haven't started tracking. Well, using [[Drop!]] during your opponent's control phase, lay down 3 high-destiny cards in your used pile and start tracking. During your move phase, just to be sure, if he has a lot of cards in hand, pay 4 Force to cut down his hopes. Then play [[The Circle Is Now Complete]], and pull those insanely high destinies you set up in his turn. Well, at least now the opponent can play [[I Can't Believe He's Gone]]....

Combos:

See if he has 13 cards in hand. Play [[Monnok]] lost to scan his hand. If you don't like what you see, [[Drop!]] 'em. Else save 4 Force.

See if he has 13 cards in hand. Play [[Monnok]] lost to scan his hand. If you don't like what you see, [[Drop!]] 'em. Then [[Voyeur]] used, saying an interrupt you saw in his hand for additional Force loss.
